scope: Narrow follow-up: session expiry codes versus invalid current code; no change to the original security report.

checks.name: Actual invalid current code returns invalid_code and keeps both client and server session valid
A correct retry after invalid_code uses the same valid session
Actual revoked fixture session returns invalid_session and clears the matching client session
Both server session error codes expire a matching authenticated request
Neither session code on a delayed old request can close the replacement session
Replacement during asynchronous JSON decoding is also protected from a stale 401
An unknown or missing 401 error code remains an operation error
A 403 does not expire the client even if its payload contains a session error code
Rejected user and admin logins preserve an already active client session
No token fails before transport and does not invent a session-expired event

limitations: No browser, DOM, HTTP listener, or real network.
Service responses are adapted in process; this is not execution of the HTTP router.
Remote CI conclusions are reviewed separately by playability_review.
